The original Slurm job requested 20G of memory (`--mem=20G`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this may under-provision the job and risk OOM.

The original Slurm job constrained scheduling via partition/QoS/account (`--partition=ai`, `--qos=ai`, `--account=ai`) but the Flux resource section has no equivalent constraints; scheduling eligibility and allocated hardware may differ.
